absent: Exact encoding of migration and device private swap entries and PMD bit layouts beyond flag preservation.
Full hugetlb reservation map lifecycle, fault handling, and cgroup charging outside listed helpers.
Boot command line parsing outcomes and default huge state selection logic.
Vmemmap optimization eligibility criteria and remap mechanics beyond call sequence.
Lock ordering among global huge lock, area locks, reservation locks, and folio locks.
Surplus accounting rules and per node pool invariants beyond dissolve adjustments.

findings.text: PMD migration installer validates a PMD only walk, captures present versus device private state with permission and soft markers, negotiates anonymous exclusivity with a sharing attempt that can report busy and restore the prior entry, selects among writable exclusive and readable migration flavors, propagates age dirty soft and userfault attributes, publishes a swap flavored entry, then drops reverse mapping and folio reference.

PMD migration remover validates a PMD only walk, rebuilds a present entry from folio and area protection with soft write userfault age and dirty handling including special protection none handling and device private conversion, reattaches anonymous or file mapping with exclusivity derived from readability, publishes at huge aligned address and updates cache.
Anonymous PMD reverse mapping helper forwards to huge aware accounting with huge page count and PMD level when transparent huge support is enabled and otherwise raises a one time warning.

Subpool creation allocates a zeroed object, initializes its lock, sets initial count with caller supplied limits and huge state, precharges minimum reservation and on accounting failure frees and returns null, otherwise records reserved count.

Node constrained huge folio allocation first attempts dequeue from available pool under global lock and returns on success, otherwise optionally restricts fallback to current node and delegates to temporary migration allocation.
Size to state lookup scans all huge states for equality of huge page size and returns first match or null when none matches.
Command line descriptor pairs a string value with a setup callback that consumes that string and returns status.
Huge state registry consists of a maximum count, a default index, and a fixed array sized by maximum huge state count plus boot time node mask and per node boot page lists.

Boot time parsing state holds pending huge state pointer, default maximum count, validity flags, per node defaults, allocation thread count, command line buffer with index and parameter table with index.
Command line argument table capacity is defined as twice the maximum huge state count plus one.
Reservation flag bits define owner as first bit, unmapped as second bit, and mask as union of both.
Reservation mode enumeration orders needs reservation, commit reservation, end reservation, add reservation, delete reservation.
Global huge page spin lock is cacheline aligned for multiprocessing and serializes pool free lists and accounting.

Huge area write locking selects shareable area lock from private data when shareable, else private reservation map semaphore, with matching unlock and nonblocking try variants that report success by default when neither applies.
Subpool reference count is protected by its own spin lock taken with interrupt state saved during release.
Reservation region list is traversed under the reservation map spin lock while accumulating overlap length over a bounded interval.
Combined unlock and free selects shareable put based unlock versus private reservation semaphore unlock without freeing.
Subpool release is a no operation on null, otherwise asserts positive count, decrements under lock and delegates final disposition to shared unlock or release helper.

Deferred free worker atomically drains a lockless free list, detaches address space linkage per folio, derives huge state from folio size rather than flag based helper, frees through pool update helper and yields scheduling between items.
Bulk allocation intake first requests vmemmap optimization for the whole list then under interrupt saved global lock accounts and enqueues each folio.

Vmemmap optimization skips empty lists, splits backing range per folio with early stop on allocation failure after counting optimizable entries, performs global translation flushes around per folio optimization, and on memory pressure flushes plus frees accumulated pages and retries before final flush and free.
Pool allocation iterates candidate nodes in allocator order attempting fresh folio allocation per node and returns first success or null.

Single folio dissolve returns success immediately when not huge, otherwise under global lock requires zero references, rejects gigantic states without runtime support and empty pools, requires freed marker with unlock plus reschedule plus retry on race, adjusts surplus accounting on removal, drops lock for vmemmap restore with rollback on failure, then frees.
Range dissolve is a no operation when huge pages unsupported, otherwise selects minimum huge order across states and steps by that stride dissolving each folio until failure or end.
Migration allocation rejects gigantic states, obtains fresh folio, accounts under global lock, unfreezes the frozen reference, marks temporary without surplus accounting and returns folio.

Area duplication handling clears private data, preserving shareable lock structures owned by another area only when needed and unconditionally clearing private reservation linkage so child faults carry no guarantee.
Reservation clearing releases owner reservation reference via cgroup aware put and reference drop when present, then invokes duplication cleanup to detach private data.
Reservation map destruction removes all regions across full range, frees cached region descriptors, asserts no additions in progress and frees the map.

Reserve count repair queries subpool for one page and when adjustment positive attempts global accounting, treats zero adjustment or successful accounting as reserved, otherwise warns about potential negative reserve.
Area lock release derives enclosing lock from reference counter and frees it.
Free work flush is conditional on vmemmap optimizability of the given huge state.
Alternative optimization helper is a no operation inline taking huge state and folio list when optimization support is disabled.
Region overlap counter walks ordered segments under lock, skips segments ending at or before interval start, stops at segments starting at or after interval end, and sums clamped overlap lengths.

PMD migration lifecycle preserves soft dirty userfault young and dirty markers from old entry into migration entry and back, with dirty also marking the folio and with device private and protection none transformations applied on restore.
Early parameter helper generates a boot time wrapper that forwards its string to a named setup routine through centralized parameter registration.
Dissolve and migration paths must not operate on gigantic states lacking runtime support because removal and restore helpers do not handle them and rollback could corrupt free lists.
PMD migration must invalidate before attempting anonymous share conversion and must restore prior entry on busy to avoid lost mapping.
